content.comment_body: Delivery release of [product_name] ([article_no]). [product_name] is an additional communications module for [product_name] [version_no]. This module enables sending and receiving SMS and transferring data from [product_name] [version_no] basic devices to AWS Cloud. With the integrated GNSS receiver (GPS), device position can be tracked and transmitted. The built-in Modbus RTU interface supports Modbus RTU stations using RS232, RS485, and RS422 interfaces. Key functions for [product_name] without Cellular Engine: • Integrated 4-port (unmanaged) switch • Built-in Modbus RTU interface (RS232, RS485, RS422) • Configuration via a web-based interface • Supported protocols: S7 communication, Modbus TCP, Modbus RTU, RESTful API • Communication with up to 4 [product_name] [version_no] basic devices (S7 communication) • Communication with up to 4 Modbus TCP devices • Time synchronization via NTP (server or client, using GNPP or Internet) Key functions for [product_name] with Cellular Engine: • SMS sending and receiving • Power ON/OFF message support • AWS Cloud connectivity for [product_name] [version_no] Important note: To operate with the Cellular Engine (not included in [product_name]), users need: • Cellular Engine • Antennas • Antenna connection cable between the Cellular Engine and antenna connector ([company_name] recommends suitable products in the documentation) • SIM card with data transmission enabled

analysis.insight_summary: The communication module introduces advanced features like cloud connectivity, SMS capability, position tracking, and multiple supported interfaces. However, to access cellular engine functions, users must purchase extra hardware, as it is not provided in the basic module. This differentiation between available standard and optional features influences how easy users perceive the product to set up and use.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to offer communication via SMS, AWS Cloud, position tracking, and Modbus protocols immediately after purchase, preferably with minimal need for additional components or accessories.
pain_keywords: not all features available out of box
